title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for intensity I(theta) as a function of theta.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the intensity pattern in the presence of jittering slit separation.

title: Interference Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the role of interference in determining the intensity pattern when both slits are open.

title: Gaussian Distribution
description: Important Criteria: The student should describe how the Gaussian distribution of slit separation affects the intensity pattern.

title: Sketch Quality
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear and accurate sketch of the intensity pattern for both parts (a) and (b).

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all variables are expressed in consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for intensity.
